# Welcome to Beatrect!

Where Music Meets Ray-Traced Graphics in VR!



# 🎵 Pure Musical Freedom

Forget everything you know about rhythm games! No more stress about perfect timing or precise movements. Just feel the music and let your body flow naturally.


# ✨ Revolutionary Ray-Traced Visuals

Experience rhythm action in a whole new light with our innovative ray-tracing technology. Every level brings you into a stunning visual environment that elevates your musical journey.



# 🎮 Features That Set Us Apart

**Pick Up and Play**

Jump right into the action - no tutorials needed
-
Intuitive controls that feel natural from the first beat
-
Perfect for both VR beginners and rhythm game veterans

**Your Style, Your Way**

Find your own rhythm and playing style
-
No pressure for perfection - just pure enjoyment
-
Play at your own pace and discover new techniques

**Level Creator**

Design your own unique levels
-
Share your creations with the community
-
Chance to be featured on our official levels page!


**Visual Excellence**

Next-gen ray-tracing graphics
-
Uniquely designed visual environments
-
Immersive VR experience



Ready to experience a new kind of rhythm game?
-
Don't think, just feel - Let the music guide you in Beatrect!
